correctness.rationale: For rate-one independent vertex clocks, thinning yields independent Poisson clocks on each undirected edge of rate deg(u)^(-1)+deg(v)^(-1). On K_(1,m), this gives E T_star=(1+H_(m-1))/lambda where lambda=(m+1)/m. On the star with added edge between source leaf 1 and leaf 2, a two-event competition before hub infection, with h=(m+2)/(2m) and c=h+1, and an independent maximum of m-2 original leaf clocks, produces the exact E T_edge formula in RESULT.md. The maximum Laplace transform F_m=prod_{i=1}^{m-2}i lambda/(i lambda+c) is derived by exponential spacings. An independent rational subset-state absorption recursion directly matched the two closed forms for m=2..8 and the exact boundary Delta_5=20155225/3059601384. Analytically Delta_m=m[P(m)+2F_mQ(m)]/[(m-1)(m+1)(m+2)(3m+2)^2], where P(m)=3m^4-10m³-32m²-28m-8>0 for m>=6 and Q(m)=m^4+4m³+3m²-4m-4>0 for m>=2. The four finite exceptions m=2..5 are exact, establishing first sign reversal at m=5; F_m<=1/(m-1) gives limit 1/3. All m>=2 covered by proof, not by bounded experiments.
